entries.reason: AVMetadataItem is a real, present class on iOS 6 (4.0); the property describes the value's own type, which is derivable from the value's Objective-C class
entries.effect: an NSString value answers com.apple.metadata.datatype.UTF-8; NSData answers JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP by sniffing the first bytes, else raw-data; NSNumber answers the signed/unsigned integer or float width its objCType names, all the release's own CMMetadataBaseDataType string values; nil for any other value
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract; the literal string values read out of CoreMedia extracted from the armv7 shared cache of iOS 8.0 with modules/apple/dyld.lua's extract

entries.reason: the item's own locale (a real, already-present property since 4.0) already carries this information in POSIX form
entries.effect: the item's locale identifier with underscores turned to hyphens, an approximate but functional BCP 47 rendering (en_US becomes en-US); nil when there is no locale
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract

entries.reason: documented as keySpace and key joined; both are real, already-present properties since 4.0
entries.effect: "<keySpace>/<key>", the key turned into a string as-is if it already is one, as a decimal number if it is an NSNumber, or as lowercase hex if it is NSData; nil when key or keySpace is missing
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract
